criteria.observation: Reported option tuples and observed rows can be reproduced for the cited experiment and run IDs.
Fixed inputs, changed factors and a linked intervention distinguish the supported cause from an alternative. A justified unresolved inference receives credit for what the comparison establishes.
For the proposed strategy the predicted per-run build outcomes and success count agree with a replay.
The predicted retained and unused caches agree with the same replay, including useful cache hits.
Local observations, modeled predictions and unobserved service behavior or frequency are identified accurately.
